zh.title: TSA PreCheck會員可免登機過安檢
zh.summary: TSA PreCheck會員可免登機過安檢；13美機場試行Gateside
body: 美國運輸安全管理局（TSA）推出 Gateside 計畫，允許 PreCheck 會員在未搭乘航班的情況下通過安檢，這項服務目前在 13 個美國機場試行。
此舉為 PreCheck 會員提供前往貴賓室、會面親友等非飛行用途的新選擇，Simple Flying 指出這擴大了會員權益。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，TSA 的 Gateside 計畫讓 PreCheck 會員無需登機即可通過安檢，並在 13 個美國機場提供服務，方便會員使用貴賓室或會面。

en.title: TSA PreCheck members can now clear security without flying at 13 US airports via Gateside program
en.summary: TSA PreCheck members clear security without flying at 13 US airports via Gateside
body: The U.S. Transportation Security Administration (TSA) has introduced the Gateside program, which permits PreCheck members to pass through security checkpoints without holding a boarding pass.
The initiative is active at 13 airports across the United States, providing members with new opportunities to visit lounges, meet arriving passengers, or access other airside facilities.
Simple Flying noted that the change expands the utility of PreCheck membership beyond traditional travel scenarios.
The expansion aims to give PreCheck members more flexibility for meetups, lounge visits, and other non‑flight activities.
Simple Flying reports that the Gateside program is now operational at the selected airports.
